purpose: Improve inspectable visual creation states in simulation; resolve adaptive Vector Cell fabrics; continuously morph exact visual states; compile richer material truth; adapt from explicit sensor readings; and compare simulation against externally supplied reality evidence without calling current knowledge perfect or turning one discrepancy into a universal rule.

properties.operation: explicit simulation, Vector Cell or Chameleon operation
properties.thought: simulation/material path: inspectable visual scene state
properties.defaults: simulation path: optional caller-visible channel defaults
properties.alternatives: simulation path: optional per-object known alternatives
properties.palette: simulation path: optional known color candidates
properties.criteria: simulation path: optional deterministic criteria such as minimum_contrast and fit_canvas
properties.max_iterations: simulation path: optional explicit bound from 1 to 32
properties.fabric: Vector Cell or chameleon path: hierarchical axm.vector-cell-fabric/v0.1 body
properties.observation_scale: Vector Cell path: positive representation-selection scale
properties.choice: Vector Cell path: explicit named choice
properties.from_thought: morph path: exact source Paintgun thought
properties.to_thought: morph path: exact target Paintgun thought
properties.from_state: Vector Cell morph/environment path: source state with observation_scale and optional choice
properties.to_state: Vector Cell morph/environment path: target state with observation_scale and optional choice
properties.material_graph: rich material declaration containing current Paintgun fields plus transmission, IOR, clearcoat, anisotropy, subsurface, normal, displacement and bounded microstructure
properties.object_id: apply-material path: exact target Paintgun object id
properties.readings: environment path: explicit supplied numeric sensor readings
properties.policy: environment path: inspectable sensor-fusion drivers and endpoint states
properties.simulation: reality path: exact completed NO_KNOWN_IMPROVEMENTS simulation
properties.observation: reality path: externally supplied source, executor and measured object fields
properties.feedback: reality path: digest-bound simulation-reality feedback receipt

contains: simulation history or Vector Cell/morph/sensor trace
rich material truth plus explicit renderer approximations
external observation provenance and discrepancy evidence when reality is compared
truthful limitations and no silent universal calibration

relationships: simulation happens before reality materialization rather than only testing after a draft is built
NO_KNOWN_IMPROVEMENTS means no currently registered improvement rule can identify another change, not perfection
Vector Cells keep stable visual identity while explicit scale/choice selects merge or split representations
continuous morphing interpolates compatible geometry and channels while incompatible topology crossfades instead of claiming impossible deformation
rich material fields stay inspectable even when the current SVG renderer only approximates a subset
environment adaptation uses explicit supplied readings and transparent weighted fusion rather than hidden learned control
externally supplied reality observations may reopen simulation; discrepancy evidence remains exact-context unless a later rule is explicitly justified
recorded calibration history is evidence for future simulator-rule design and never becomes authority or hidden self-modification

anatomy_refs.basis: The simulated visual thought keeps shape, surface, color, light, shade and skin parameters as an inspectable compositional graph before rendering.
Simulation advances through explicit state transitions and terminates in typed stop or HOLD states.
Vector Cells select one exact scale-bound representation and can collapse or expand child detail.
Nested cells retain explicit parent/child paths and resolve into an inspectable scene graph.
Two exact visual endpoints produce a bounded deterministic intermediate state with explicit factor and topology handling.
Morph factor drives continuous visual interpolation/crossfade across a reproducible 0..1 transition.
Rich material properties are normalized as one inspectable graph and compiled into Paintgun-compatible channels plus retained truth.
Bounded microstructure modes compile deterministically to current renderer approximations while source parameters remain explicit.
The compiler validates rich material declarations and emits exact Paintgun material/color/skin/light/shade channels plus approximation evidence.
Explicit numeric sensor readings are normalized against declared ranges and retained with their adaptation contribution.
Multiple explicit readings are fused through declared weights into a continuous adaptation factor driving a chameleon morph.
Rich materials retain a procedural normal descriptor while the current SVG generation marks it as metadata rather than claiming full normal-map rendering.
Reality feedback requires explicit observation source, executor, measurements and a digest-bound comparison against simulated state.
The explicit 0..1 factor is the bounded weight of every intermediate morph state.

limitations: simulation improvement rules remain bounded to explicitly implemented rules
NO_KNOWN_IMPROVEMENTS is not optimality, perfection, semantic correctness or aesthetic proof
Vector Cells select only supplied representations and never invent missing close-up detail
compatible morph geometry is currently bounded to Paintgun rect/circle/ellipse/polygon shapes; incompatible shapes/topology crossfade
rich material truth exceeds current SVG rendering: normal, displacement, refraction/IOR, anisotropy and subsurface are descriptors or labeled approximations rather than physical rendering
environment readings are supplied observations; no hardware/browser sensor sampling is claimed
sensor fusion is a transparent weighted normalized policy, not hidden learned control
reality recalibration is first-order numeric exact-condition correction and may still be wrong on the next observation
one or repeated observations are not silently generalized into universal simulator laws
persistent_state: state/simulation-calibration.json only when record-calibration is explicitly invoked

truth.basis: Adaptive representations, morph endpoints/factor, rich material truth, renderer approximations, sensor readings/weights, external observations, discrepancies and calibration receipts all remain inspectable.

agency.basis: Scale, choice, morph factor, material graph, sensor policy and calibration recording are explicit caller-visible state rather than hidden adaptation.

continuity.basis: Cell identity and exact thought lineage are preserved where possible; topology changes use bounded crossfade and calibration evidence does not rewrite the machine body.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Simulation stays before materialization, richer truth is separated from current renderer approximation, and observed reality can reopen the simulator instead of protecting an earlier story.
